title: 3C Detox App
meta: Flutter × Dart × Kotlin (native Android foreground monitoring)
soWhat: Self-built app that limits phone usage time, removing the recurring subscription cost that ordinary screen-time apps put on your cash flow.
problem: Daily life is easily pulled apart by outside stimuli such as social media, yet the usual Pomodoro apps only keep time — they never block the apps that actually distract you. The apps that do offer real blocking tend to put it behind a paid plan, so to cut the long-term cash outflow I built an app with those capabilities myself.
role: Used AI-assisted development on a Flutter project to build the 3C Detox app.
method: On Android, native Kotlin hooks into UsageStatsManager to monitor the foreground app, and opening a blocked app forces a switch to the focus screen
Immersive music during a focus session

figures.caption: Focus timer: Pomodoro and strict-mode settings, then the running countdown. Strict mode uses Android foreground monitoring to block the apps on the blocklist.
Schedules: weekly recurring block windows, each bound to a different blocklist and enabled or disabled individually.
